text: Owner's answer (2026-11-25) to the open business rule on in/hr-position-salary-access: only ADMIN assigns positions (and so their roles and salary). hr.attendance.manage may not assign or move staff between positions; keep main's rule that without identity.users.manage nobody gives roles.
